description: This Java interface defines API endpoints for running reports in the Fineract client, including methods for retrieving report data and files, with detailed documentation and URL patterns.

classes.name: RunReportsApi
classes.description: Interface for executing report-related API calls in Fineract, supporting report data retrieval and file export.

methods.name: runReportGetData
methods.description: Executes a GET request to retrieve report data in JSON format, with parameters and optional self-service flag.

methods.name: runReportGetFile
methods.description: Executes a GET request to retrieve report output as a file (PDF, CSV, XLS, etc.), with parameters and optional self-service flag.
